source.origin: 北京舞蹈学院中国民族民间舞教材，明文军示范，山东鼓子秧歌·狗熊哆嗦毛（后半段，近景特写之后）

notes: Starts right after a close-up shot: landing (L foot), wide 'X' stance with arms spread (R foot slides), L foot lifts sideways and closes, then the characteristic shake: arms beat down while the whole body quivers (2D ankle speed oscillates 0.2-5% leg/frame on both feet simultaneously; small bounces cannot be ruled out, so contacts there are 'unsure'), then stand. Performer drifts away from the camera.
